Serialize a compiled function

Source: R/compilation_cache.R
experimental_serialize_executable_serialize.Rd

Ports of jax.experimental.serialize_executable.serialize and deserialize_and_load. experimental_serialize_executable_serialize() takes the result of jit(f)$lower(...)$compile() and returns list(payload, in_tree, out_tree): payload is a raw vector with the executable and its constants, which can be saved and loaded again by a later R session on the same platform with the same XLA runtime. deserialize_and_load() rebuilds the compiled function from the three parts.

Usage

experimental_serialize_executable_serialize(compiled)

experimental_serialize_executable_deserialize_and_load(
  serialized,
  in_tree,
  out_tree
)

Arguments

compiled

A compiled function from $compile().

serialized

The payload.

in_tree, out_tree

The trees returned with the payload.

Value

serialize: list(payload, in_tree, out_tree). deserialize_and_load: a compiled function.

Details

As with JAX, the payload is trusted: loading it runs native code and R's unserialize(). Only load payloads you made yourself.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
f <- jit(function(x) x * 2)
compiled <- f$lower(as_jax(c(1, 2)))$compile()
s <- experimental_serialize_executable_serialize(compiled)
g <- experimental_serialize_executable_deserialize_and_load(s[[1]], s[[2]], s[[3]])
g(as_jax(c(3, 4)))
} # }
